Story Acceptance Criteria: Given any significant account activity occurs (e.g., password change, profile update), when the activity is completed, then an email notification is sent to the patient's registered email address.
The email should include details of the activity and any necessary follow-up actions.

Tasks.Description: Set up an email notification service using a suitable library (e.g., Flask-Mail) to send emails from the application.
Create a function to trigger email notifications for significant account activities such as password changes and profile updates.
Develop a template for the email notification that includes details of the activity and any necessary follow-up actions.
Implement logic to detect significant account activities (e.g., password change, profile update) within the application.
Integrate the email notification function with the logic that detects significant account activities to automatically send an email when such activities occur.
Ensure that the email notification function retrieves the patient's registered email address from the database.
Test the email notification function to verify that emails are sent correctly upon significant account activities.
Add logging to the email notification function to record when emails are sent and any errors that occur during the process.
Update the user interface to inform patients that they will receive email notifications for significant account activities.
Deploy the email notification service to the production environment and monitor for any issues.
